objective: Import bounded TSV records with honest mapped parser results, safe row keys and exact ordered callback/error behavior.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Mapped ReturnType schemas and unknown-error narrowing remain current TypeScript techniques.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Bounded tabular text ingestion is practical admin/data-adapter work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Column indexing, safe dynamic keys and callback/error ordering transfer to other importers.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Explicit bounded TSV rules isolate this intermediate parser exercise from full CSV/file handling.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Prototype-key assignment or receiver-dependent parser calls can lose valid rows or produce inconsistent results.

defects: Reference/junior assigned parsed __proto__ values into ordinary objects, losing own data.
Parser receiver differed between direct schema method calls and junior local functions.
Junior/senior repeatedly searched header positions per record despite the once-per-column guidance.
Duplicate headers, empty schema, blank trimming, opaque parser outputs and callback lifetime were incomplete.
rationale: Use safe row dictionaries in reference/junior and keep fromEntries senior. Precompute all header positions and invoke local parser functions consistently. Define own enumerable string schema keys/order, first duplicate-header selection, trim-blank physical line handling, no parser calls on missing headers, exactly one plain argument per parser, continued schema checks after a rejected cell, exact Error/String messages and opaque returned values/undefined without awaiting. Five runtime assertions inspect literal prototype keys/strict receiver, every-cell rejection ordering with blank-line numbers, missing preflight/duplicate headers/empty schema, independent opaque results and1000 rows by20 fields. Add a constructor/__proto__ mapped-return static check and retain existing error/narrowing tests. Target O(L+k*h+r*k+E), explicitly including input/error text and excluding parser work; unsupported dimensions hide the estimate and keep25 XP under419. The final fromEntries alternative was prepared before baseline and remains valid.

objective: Aggregate ordered finite points into safe observed player entries with an honest optional lookup type.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Partial records and keyed aggregation remain current TypeScript techniques.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Summing grouped activity data is practical application processing.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Observed versus possible keys, prototype safety and ordered Number folds transfer to other accumulators.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Bounded player names/points isolate the intermediate dictionary lesson.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Inherited Object names and falsely required index signatures can return functions or promise nonexistent numbers.

defects: All original plain-object totals mishandled prototype-like player names.
Required Record<string,number> and a public positive number lookup promised an absent player total.
Junior started a new player directly from points, differing from numeric-zero folding for signed zero.
Original plain dictionary passed every old simple-name example.
rationale: Rewrite the English contract, starter/scaffold/hints/steps and all boards to Partial<Record<string,number>> with prototype-safe fresh totals. Correct two public required-lookup expectations and add an unsafe absent-number rejection plus a general string-key optional lookup. Use zero before every addition, including a new signed-zero player, and retain exact ordered Number folds. Four runtime assertions inspect constructor/__proto__/toString/empty names and absent inherited names; fractional/signed-zero/case/space names with independent bags; order-sensitive finite arithmetic; and1000 rounds. Final Map alternative adopts Partial after the old required-Record baseline, preserving numeric input order and safe output keys. An initial constructor dot-property type assertion hit TypeScript’s inherited Object Function typing; replace it with a general string index lookup before approval. Runtime prototype-key tests remain separate. Target linear bounded keyed work/output.
